structured_output.summary: The change implements Object.prototype.isPrototypeOf as the spec describes. It checks that value is an Object first and returns false if not. It then calls ToObject(this) with `?`. It then loops: [[GetPrototypeOf]] with `?` propagation, return false on null, and return true if SameValue matches. The step order matches the spec, so a non-object value with an undefined or null `this` still returns false. The two remaining failures are Proxy [[GetPrototypeOf]] not-implemented errors raised outside this file, which is honest partial work. The only other edit is renaming `new_target` to `_new_target`, which is needed because the parameter is now unused.
